argv: const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const roots=['src/registry','src/cli/roles.js','src/cli/skills.js','src/cli/workflows.js'];const bad=[];const walk=d=>{const st=fs.statSync(d);if(st.isDirectory()){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d))walk(p.join(d,e));}else if(/[\u4e00-\u9fff]/.test(fs.readFileSync(d,'utf8')))bad.push(d);};roots.forEach(walk);if(bad.length){console.log(bad.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}console.log('OK: no CJK');
